#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 20260907-1520- UOS Fractal Matrix generator (find/grep/jq/awk pipeline).
# Run from the repo workspace root. Reads: apps/, engines/, services/, tools/, native/,
# apps/uos_swarm/src/uos_swarm/holon.gleam, apps/uos_tui/src/uos_tui/aspects.gleam, and the
# external census JSON (path in CENSUS env var). Writes generated/20260907-1520-uos-fractal-matrix.json.
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$(pwd)"
CENSUS="${CENSUS:?set CENSUS=/path/to/census-for-matrix.json}"
OUT_JSON="generated/20260907-1520-uos-fractal-matrix.json"
WORK="${WORK:-$(mktemp -d)}"
mkdir -p "$WORK"

# ---------- 1. Subsystem inventory ----------------------------------------------------------
: > "$WORK/subsystems.tsv"   # tree, subsys_id, path, kind
find apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | sort | while read -r d; do
  base="${d##*/}"
  printf 'cepaf\tcepaf.%s\t%s\tpercomponent\n' "$base" "$d"
done >> "$WORK/subsystems.tsv"
printf 'cepaf\tcepaf.top\tapps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam\tpercomponent-top\n' >> "$WORK/subsystems.tsv"
printf 'indrajaal\tindrajaal.core\tapps/indrajaal_gleam_web/src/indrajaal\tpercomponent\n' >> "$WORK/subsystems.tsv"
printf 'indrajaal\tindrajaal.web\tapps/indrajaal_gleam_web/src/indrajaal_gleam_web\tpercomponent\n' >> "$WORK/subsystems.tsv"
printf 'uos_swarm\tuos_swarm\tapps/uos_swarm/src/uos_swarm\tpercomponent\n' >> "$WORK/subsystems.tsv"
printf 'uos_tui\tuos_tui\tapps/uos_tui/src/uos_tui\tpercomponent\n' >> "$WORK/subsystems.tsv"
find engines/hermes/modules -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | sort | while read -r d; do
  base="${d##*/}"
  printf 'hermes\thermes.%s\t%s\taggregate\n' "$base" "$d"
done >> "$WORK/subsystems.tsv"
printf 'zigvm\tzigvm.src-root\tengines/zigvm/src\taggregate-top\n' >> "$WORK/subsystems.tsv"
printf 'zigvm\tzigvm.bifs\tengines/zigvm/src/bifs\taggregate\n' >> "$WORK/subsystems.tsv"
printf 'zigvm\tzigvm.substrate\tengines/zigvm/src/substrate\taggregate\n' >> "$WORK/subsystems.tsv"
printf 'max\tmax\tservices/inference/max\tpercomponent\n' >> "$WORK/subsystems.tsv"
printf 'tools\ttools\ttools\taggregate-entries\n' >> "$WORK/subsystems.tsv"
for d in c cpp ocaml rust; do
  printf 'nifs\tnifs.%s\tnative/nifs/%s\tpercomponent\n' "$d" "$d"
done >> "$WORK/subsystems.tsv"

# ---------- 2. holon.gleam holarchy() extraction ----------------------------------------------
HOLON_SRC="apps/uos_swarm/src/uos_swarm/holon.gleam"
start=$(grep -n '^pub fn holarchy' "$HOLON_SRC" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
end=$(awk -v s="$start" 'NR>s && /^pub fn /{print NR; exit}' "$HOLON_SRC")
sed -n "${start},${end}p" "$HOLON_SRC" > "$WORK/holarchy_block.gleam"

awk '
function resetblk() { n=0; id=""; name=""; level=""; plane=""; module=""; audit=""; board=""; inlist=0 }
BEGIN { resetblk() }
/^[ \t]*Holon\($/ { inblk=1; resetblk(); next }
inblk && /^[ \t]*\),?[ \t]*$/ {
  inblk=0
  print id"\t"name"\t"level"\t"plane"\t"module"\t"audit"\t"board
  next
}
inblk {
  line=$0
  sub(/^[ \t]+/,"",line); sub(/[ \t]*$/,"",line)
  if (inlist) { if (line ~ /\],?$/) inlist=0; next }
  if (line ~ /^\[/ && line !~ /\],?$/) { inlist=1; n++; next }
  sub(/,$/,"",line)
  n++
  if (n==1) id=line
  else if (n==2) name=line
  else if (n==4) level=line
  else if (n==5) plane=line
  else if (n==8) module=line
  else if (n==9) audit=line
  else if (n==10) board=line
}
' "$WORK/holarchy_block.gleam" > "$WORK/holons.tsv"

# Component-name -> holon match table: strip quotes/annotation from module, split tree/base.
awk -F'\t' '
{
  id=$1; level=$3; plane=$4; module=$5
  gsub(/^"|"$/,"",module); sub(/ \(.*$/,"",module)
  n=split(module,p,"/"); base=p[n]; tree=(n>=2)?p[1]:"?"
  print base"\t"tree"\t"id"\t"level"\t"plane
}' "$WORK/holons.tsv" | sort -u > "$WORK/holon_component_map.tsv"

# ---------- 3. 17-aspect list ------------------------------------------------------------------
awk '/^pub type Aspect \{/{f=1;next} f&&/^\}/{exit} f{gsub(/^[ \t]+/,"");print}' \
  apps/uos_tui/src/uos_tui/aspects.gleam > "$WORK/aspects.txt"

# ---------- 4. Zenoh-key literals, non-test, mapped to subsystem by longest-prefix -------------
grep -rEon '"(indrajaal|c3i|uos)/[a-zA-Z0-9_/*{}-]+"' apps engines services tools native 2>/dev/null \
  | grep -v '/test/' > "$WORK/zenoh_raw.txt" || true
awk -F'\t' '
BEGIN{OFS="\t"}
NR==FNR{spath[NR]=$3;sid[NR]=$2;n=NR;next}
{
  split($0,a,":"); file=a[1]; line=a[2]
  rest=$0; sub(/^[^:]+:[0-9]+:/,"",rest); key=rest
  best=""; bestlen=-1; bestid=""
  for(i=1;i<=n;i++){p=spath[i]; if(index(file,p"/")==1||file==p){ if(length(p)>bestlen){bestlen=length(p);bestid=sid[i]} }}
  if(bestid!="") print bestid, key, file":"line
}' "$WORK/subsystems.tsv" "$WORK/zenoh_raw.txt" > "$WORK/zenoh_mapped.tsv"

# domain/layer evidence: indrajaal/l<n>/<domain> literals only, production files
grep -rEon '"indrajaal/(l[0-9])/([a-z_]+)' apps engines services tools native 2>/dev/null \
  | grep -v '/test/' \
  | sed -E 's/^([^:]+):([0-9]+):"indrajaal\/(l[0-9])\/([a-z_]+)$/\1\t\2\t\3\t\4/' > "$WORK/domain_evidence_prod.tsv" || true
awk -F'\t' '
BEGIN{OFS="\t"}
NR==FNR{spath[NR]=$3;sid[NR]=$2;n=NR;next}
{
  file=$1;line=$2;layer=$3;domain=$4
  best=""; bestlen=-1; bestid=""
  for(i=1;i<=n;i++){p=spath[i]; if(index(file,p"/")==1||file==p){ if(length(p)>bestlen){bestlen=length(p);bestid=sid[i]} }}
  if(bestid!="") print bestid, layer, domain, file":"line
}' "$WORK/subsystems.tsv" "$WORK/domain_evidence_prod.tsv" > "$WORK/domain_evidence_mapped.tsv"

awk -F'\t' '{k=$1"\t"$2"\t"$3; cnt[k]++; if(!(k in ev)) ev[k]=$4} END{for(k in cnt) print k"\t"cnt[k]"\t"ev[k]}' \
  "$WORK/domain_evidence_mapped.tsv" > "$WORK/domain_tally.tsv"
awk -F'\t' '
{
  sid=$1; layer=$2; domain=$3; cnt=$4; ev=$5
  if(!(sid in best) || cnt>bestcnt[sid] || (cnt==bestcnt[sid] && layer<bestlayer[sid])){
    best[sid]=layer"\t"domain"\t"cnt"\t"ev; bestcnt[sid]=cnt; bestlayer[sid]=layer
  }
}
END{for(s in best) print s"\t"best[s]}' "$WORK/domain_tally.tsv" | sort > "$WORK/subsystem_layer_ruleA.tsv"

# Rule B: directory-basename exact match against the design-doc domain->layer table.
awk -F'\t' '
{
  sid=$2; path=$3; n=split(path,parts,"/"); base=parts[n]; layer=""
  if(base=="const"||base=="iam"||base=="secret") layer="l0"
  else if(base=="atomic") layer="l1"
  else if(base=="system"||base=="cpig"||base=="sync"||base=="sched") layer="l4"
  else if(base=="cog"||base=="test") layer="l5"
  else if(base=="eco") layer="l6"
  else if(base=="fed"||base=="matrix"||base=="fmea") layer="l7"
  else if(base=="otel"||base=="pi"||base=="kms"||base=="safety"||base=="moz") layer="flat"
  if(layer!="") print sid"\t"base"\t"layer
}' "$WORK/subsystems.tsv" > "$WORK/subsystem_layer_ruleB.tsv"

# ---------- 5. Supervisor edges -----------------------------------------------------------------
grep -rnE 'sup\.add\([a-zA-Z_.]+\.supervised\(\)\)' apps/cepaf_gleam/src 2>/dev/null > "$WORK/sup_add_raw.txt" || true

# ---------- 6. Routes (distinct, from ui/wisp/router.gleam) --------------------------------------
grep -noE '"/[a-zA-Z0-9_/-]*"' apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/ui/wisp/router.gleam 2>/dev/null \
  | sort -u -t: -k2 > "$WORK/routes_raw.txt" || true

# ---------- 7. NIF loaders ------------------------------------------------------------------------
find apps native -iname "*_nif.erl" > "$WORK/nif_files.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
: > "$WORK/nif_loaders.tsv"
while read -r f; do
  matches=$(grep -nE 'load_nif\(' "$f" || true)
  [ -z "$matches" ] && continue
  while IFS=: read -r ln rest; do
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s:%s\n' "$f" "$rest" "$f" "$ln" >> "$WORK/nif_loaders.tsv"
  done <<< "$matches"
done < "$WORK/nif_files.txt"

# ---------- 8. sa-plan / board interaction lines --------------------------------------------------
grep -rnE 'sa_plan|sa-plan' apps engines 2>/dev/null | grep -v '/test/' > "$WORK/saplan_raw.txt" || true
grep -rnE 'board\.(post|send|publish)' apps 2>/dev/null | grep -v '/test/' > "$WORK/board_raw.txt" || true

echo "STAGE1 done: $(wc -l < "$WORK/subsystems.tsv") subsystems, $(wc -l < "$WORK/holons.tsv") holons"

# ---------- 9. Cross-cutting service evidence dumps (whole tree, excludes priv/ build output) --
SCAN_DIRS="apps engines services tools native"
declare -A SVC_PAT=(
  [logging]='io\.println|logger|logging|tracing'
  [observability]='otel|telemetry|trace_id|span|metrics|kpi'
  [security]='auth|iam|rbac|oidc|jwt|vault|secret|acl|signature|hmac|digest'
  [safety]='stpa|fmea|uca|andon|jidoka|circuit_breaker|freshness|watchdog|fail_closed'
  [clock]='monotonic|lamport|clock|ntp|timestamp'
  [persistence]='sqlite|ets|ledger|jsonl|wal'
  [messaging]='zenoh|board|a2a|mcp'
  [planning]='sa_plan|planning|task|workflow'
  [formal]='lean|quint|gospel|z3|\blaw\b'
  [knowledge]='wiki|zk|ontology|sutra|gita|raga'
)
mkdir -p "$WORK/svc"
for svc in "${!SVC_PAT[@]}"; do
  grep -rliE "${SVC_PAT[$svc]}" $SCAN_DIRS 2>/dev/null \
    | grep -v '/priv/' | grep -v '/uos_swarm/swarm/' > "$WORK/svc/$svc.files" || true
done
echo "SVC done: $(for s in "${!SVC_PAT[@]}"; do wc -l < "$WORK/svc/$s.files"; done | paste -sd+ | bc 2>/dev/null || true)"

# ---------- 10. Component enumeration per 'percomponent' subsystem ------------------------------
: > "$WORK/components.tsv"   # sid, file(relpath), ext, externals, has_test, svc_csv
: > "$WORK/aggregate.tsv"    # sid, file_count, ext_summary

while IFS=$'\t' read -r tree sid path kind; do
  case "$kind" in
    percomponent|percomponent-top)
      if [ "$kind" = "percomponent-top" ]; then
        files=$(find "$path" -maxdepth 1 -name "*.gleam" 2>/dev/null)
      else
        case "$tree" in
          max) files=$(find "$path" -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name "*.py" -o -name "*.mojo" -o -name "*.md" \) 2>/dev/null) ;;
          nifs) files=$(find "$path" -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name "*.rs" -o -name "*.c" -o -name "*.cpp" -o -name "*.ml" -o -name "*.toml" \) 2>/dev/null) ;;
          *) files=$(find "$path" -maxdepth 3 -name "*.gleam" 2>/dev/null) ;;
        esac
      fi
      [ -z "$files" ] && continue
      while read -r f; do
        [ -z "$f" ] && continue
        ext_count=$(grep -c '@external(erlang' "$f" 2>/dev/null) || true
        ext_count="${ext_count:-0}"
        base="${f##*/}"; base_noext="${base%.*}"
        has_test="no"
        for tf in apps/cepaf_gleam/test apps/uos_swarm/test apps/uos_tui/test apps/indrajaal_gleam_web/test; do
          if [ -d "$tf" ] && find "$tf" -iname "*${base_noext}*" 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then has_test="yes"; break; fi
        done
        svcs=""
        for svc in "${!SVC_PAT[@]}"; do
          if grep -qxF "$f" "$WORK/svc/$svc.files" 2>/dev/null; then svcs="${svcs}${svc},"; fi
        done
        printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$sid" "$f" "$ext_count" "$has_test" "$svcs" "$base" >> "$WORK/components.tsv"
      done <<< "$files"
      ;;
    aggregate|aggregate-top|aggregate-entries)
      if [ "$kind" = "aggregate-entries" ]; then
        cnt=$(find "$path" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
        subd=$(find "$path" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
        printf '%s\t%s files + %s subdir entries (aggregated)\n' "$sid" "$cnt" "$subd" >> "$WORK/aggregate.tsv"
      elif [ "$kind" = "aggregate-top" ]; then
        cnt=$(find "$path" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "*.zig" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
        printf '%s\t%s .zig files at top level (aggregated, excludes bifs/substrate subsystems)\n' "$sid" "$cnt" >> "$WORK/aggregate.tsv"
      else
        case "$tree" in
          hermes) cnt=$(find "$path" -type f \( -name "*.ml" -o -name "*.mli" \) 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') ;;
          zigvm)  cnt=$(find "$path" -type f -name "*.zig" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') ;;
          *)      cnt=$(find "$path" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') ;;
        esac
        printf '%s\t%s files recursively (aggregated)\n' "$sid" "$cnt" >> "$WORK/aggregate.tsv"
      fi
      ;;
  esac
done < "$WORK/subsystems.tsv"

echo "STAGE2 done: $(wc -l < "$WORK/components.tsv") per-file components, $(wc -l < "$WORK/aggregate.tsv") aggregate subsystems"

# ---------- 11. Convert TSVs to JSON, join holon matches -----------------------------------------
jq -R -c 'split("\t") | {sid:.[0], file:.[1], externals:(.[2]|tonumber), has_test:(.[3]=="yes"), services:(.[4]|split(",")|map(select(length>0))), base:.[5]}' \
  "$WORK/components.tsv" | jq -s '.' > "$WORK/components.json"

awk -F'\t' '{gsub(/"/,"",$1); gsub(/"/,"",$3); base=$1; id=$3; level=$4; plane=$5;
  if(!(base in bestlevel) || level+0>bestlevel[base]){bestlevel[base]=level+0; bestid[base]=id; bestplane[base]=plane}}
  END{for(b in bestid) print b"\t"bestid[b]"\t"bestlevel[b]"\t"bestplane[b]}' "$WORK/holon_component_map.tsv" \
  > "$WORK/holon_best_by_base.tsv"
jq -R -c 'split("\t") | {base:.[0], holon_id:.[1], holon_level:(.[2]|tonumber), holon_plane:.[3]}' \
  "$WORK/holon_best_by_base.tsv" | jq -s '.' > "$WORK/holon_best.json"

jq --slurpfile hb "$WORK/holon_best.json" '
  ($hb[0] | map({(.base): .}) | add) as $hmap
  | map(
      (.base | sub("\\.gleam$";"") | sub("\\.py$";"") | sub("\\.rs$";"") | sub("\\.erl$";"")) as $stem
      | . + (if (.sid=="uos_tui" or .sid=="uos_swarm") and $hmap[$stem]
             then {holon_id: $hmap[$stem].holon_id, holon_level: $hmap[$stem].holon_level, holon_plane: $hmap[$stem].holon_plane}
             else {} end)
    )
' "$WORK/components.json" > "$WORK/components_with_holon.json"

# ---------- 12. Census row -> subsystem mapping (substring of subsystem basename in census name) -
awk -F'\t' '{n=split($3,p,"/"); print $2"\t"p[n]}' "$WORK/subsystems.tsv" \
  | jq -R -c 'split("\t")|{sid:.[0], base:.[1]}' | jq -s '.' > "$WORK/subsys_bases.json"
jq -c --slurpfile subs "$WORK/subsys_bases.json" '
  . as $census
  | ($subs[0] | map(select(.base|length>=3))) as $bases
  | [ $census[] | . as $row |
      (($row.name|ascii_downcase)) as $n
      | ( [$bases[] | . as $x | ($x.base|ascii_downcase) as $b | select($n|contains($b)) | $x.sid ] | unique ) as $matched
      | { name: $row.name, class: $row.class, uos_status: $row.uos_status, matched_sids: $matched }
    ]
' "$CENSUS" > "$WORK/census_mapped.json"
jq -c '
  [ .[] | .matched_sids[] as $s | {sid:$s, status:.uos_status, name:.name} ]
  | group_by(.sid)
  | map({ sid: .[0].sid, count: length,
          statuses: (map(.status) | group_by(.) | map({(.[0]): length}) | add),
          sample_names: (map(.name) | .[0:4]) })
' "$WORK/census_mapped.json" > "$WORK/census_by_subsystem.json"
jq -c '[.[] | select(.matched_sids|length==0) | {name,class,uos_status}]' "$WORK/census_mapped.json" > "$WORK/census_unmatched.json"

echo "STAGE3 done: $(jq '[.[] | select(.holon_id!=null)] | length' "$WORK/components_with_holon.json") holon-linked components, \
$(jq 'length' "$WORK/census_by_subsystem.json") subsystems with census evidence, \
$(jq 'length' "$WORK/census_unmatched.json") unmatched census rows"

# ---------- 13. Interactions: zenoh-key, supervisor, route, nif, sa-plan, board, ffi --------------
jq -R -c 'split("\t") | {kind:"zenoh-key", source:.[0], target:.[1], evidence:.[2]}' "$WORK/zenoh_mapped.tsv" | jq -s '.' > "$WORK/int_zenoh.json"
jq -R -c '
  split(":") as $p | ($p[0]) as $file | ($p[1]) as $line | ($p[2:] | join(":")) as $rest
  | ($rest | capture("sup\\.add\\((?<child>[a-zA-Z_.]+)\\.supervised")) as $c
  | {kind:"supervisor-child", source:$file, target:$c.child, evidence:($file+":"+$line)}
' "$WORK/sup_add_raw.txt" | jq -s '.' > "$WORK/int_sup_add.json"

cat > "$WORK/int_sup_root.json" << 'JSONEOF'
[
{"kind":"supervisor-child","source":"UOSRootSupervisor","target":"AppsSupervisor","evidence":"apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/uos_sup.gleam:69"},
{"kind":"supervisor-child","source":"UOSRootSupervisor","target":"EnginesSupervisor","evidence":"apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/uos_sup.gleam:80"},
{"kind":"supervisor-child","source":"UOSRootSupervisor","target":"ServicesSupervisor","evidence":"apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/uos_sup.gleam:86"},
{"kind":"supervisor-child","source":"UOSRootSupervisor","target":"IntelligenceSupervisor","evidence":"apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/uos_sup.gleam:97"},
{"kind":"supervisor-child","source":"AppsSupervisor","target":"cepaf_gleam_wisp","evidence":"apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/uos_sup.gleam:73"},
{"kind":"supervisor-child","source":"AppsSupervisor","target":"indrajaal_holon_runtime","evidence":"apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/uos_sup.gleam:74"},
{"kind":"supervisor-child","source":"AppsSupervisor","target":"indrajaal_web","evidence":"apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/uos_sup.gleam:75"},
{"kind":"supervisor-child","source":"EnginesSupervisor","target":"zigvm_port_manager","evidence":"apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/uos_sup.gleam:83"},
{"kind":"supervisor-child","source":"EnginesSupervisor","target":"hermes_oracle_supervisor","evidence":"apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/uos_sup.gleam:83"},
{"kind":"supervisor-child","source":"ServicesSupervisor","target":"max_isolated_worker","evidence":"apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/uos_sup.gleam:90"},
{"kind":"supervisor-child","source":"ServicesSupervisor","target":"mcp_unified_gateway","evidence":"apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/uos_sup.gleam:91"},
{"kind":"supervisor-child","source":"ServicesSupervisor","target":"planning_worker","evidence":"apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/uos_sup.gleam:92"},
{"kind":"supervisor-child","source":"ServicesSupervisor","target":"predictive_zenoh_stream","evidence":"apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/uos_sup.gleam:93"},
{"kind":"supervisor-child","source":"IntelligenceSupervisor","target":"holon_swarm_mesh","evidence":"apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/uos_sup.gleam:100"},
{"kind":"supervisor-child","source":"IntelligenceSupervisor","target":"lease_fencing_monitor","evidence":"apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/uos_sup.gleam:101"},
{"kind":"supervisor-child","source":"IntelligenceSupervisor","target":"rete_ul_engine","evidence":"apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/uos_sup.gleam:102"}
]
JSONEOF
jq -s 'add' "$WORK/int_sup_root.json" "$WORK/int_sup_add.json" > "$WORK/int_supervisor.json"

awk -F: '{line=$1; $1=""; sub(/^:/,""); route=$0; if(!(route in seen)){seen[route]=line}} END{for(r in seen) print r"\t"seen[r]}' \
  "$WORK/routes_raw.txt" | sort -u > "$WORK/routes_distinct.tsv"
jq -R -c 'split("\t") | {kind:"route", source:"apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/ui/wisp/router.gleam", target:.[0], evidence:("apps/cepaf_gleam/src/cepaf_gleam/ui/wisp/router.gleam:"+.[1])}' \
  "$WORK/routes_distinct.tsv" | jq -s '.' > "$WORK/int_routes.json"

jq -R -c 'split("\t") | {kind:"nif", source:.[0], target:(.[2]|split(":")[0] + " (erlang:load_nif)"), evidence:.[2]}' \
  "$WORK/nif_loaders.tsv" | jq -s '.' > "$WORK/int_nif.json"

awk -F: '{f=$1; if(!(f in seen)){seen[f]=$0; cnt++} } END{for(f in seen) print seen[f]}' "$WORK/saplan_raw.txt" | head -60 > "$WORK/saplan_sample.txt"
jq -R -c 'split(":") as $p | {kind:"sa-plan", source:$p[0], target:"sa-plan", evidence:($p[0]+":"+$p[1])}' "$WORK/saplan_sample.txt" | jq -s '.' > "$WORK/int_saplan.json"

jq -R -c 'split(":") as $p | {kind:"board", source:$p[0], target:"board.post", evidence:($p[0]+":"+$p[1])}' "$WORK/board_raw.txt" | jq -s '.' > "$WORK/int_board.json"

jq -c '[.[] | select(.externals>0)] | sort_by(-.externals) | .[0:15] | map({kind:"ffi", source:.file, target:("@external(erlang) x"+(.externals|tostring)), evidence:.file})' \
  "$WORK/components_with_holon.json" > "$WORK/int_ffi.json"

jq -s 'add' "$WORK/int_zenoh.json" "$WORK/int_supervisor.json" "$WORK/int_routes.json" "$WORK/int_nif.json" "$WORK/int_saplan.json" "$WORK/int_board.json" "$WORK/int_ffi.json" \
  > "$WORK/interactions_all.json"
echo "STAGE4 done: $(jq 'length' "$WORK/interactions_all.json") interaction rows"

# ---------- 14. Assemble subsystems array (layer/plane/domain rule, components, census) ----------
jq -R -c 'split("\t") | {tree:.[0], sid:.[1], path:.[2], kind:.[3]}' "$WORK/subsystems.tsv" | jq -s '.' > "$WORK/subsystems_base.json"
jq -R -c 'split("\t") | {sid:.[0], layer:.[1], domain:.[2], count:(.[3]|tonumber), evidence:.[4]}' "$WORK/subsystem_layer_ruleA.tsv" | jq -s '.' > "$WORK/ruleA.json"
jq -R -c 'split("\t") | {sid:.[0], base:.[1], layer:.[2]}' "$WORK/subsystem_layer_ruleB.tsv" | jq -s '.' > "$WORK/ruleB.json"
jq -R -c 'split("\t") | {sid:.[0], summary:.[1]}' "$WORK/aggregate.tsv" | jq -s '.' > "$WORK/aggregate.json"

jq -c -s '
  . as $all
  | $all[0] as $base | $all[1] as $ruleA | $all[2] as $ruleB | $all[3] as $agg
  | ($all[4] | group_by(.sid) | map({(.[0].sid): map(del(.sid))}) | add) as $compsBySid
  | ($all[5] | map({(.sid): .}) | add) as $censusBySid
  | ($ruleA | map({(.sid): .}) | add) as $ruleAmap
  | ($ruleB | map({(.sid): .}) | add) as $ruleBmap
  | ($agg | map({(.sid): .summary}) | add) as $aggmap
  | [ $base[] | . as $s
      | ($ruleAmap[$s.sid]) as $ra
      | ($ruleBmap[$s.sid]) as $rb
      | (if $ra then {layer:$ra.layer, domain:$ra.domain, rule:"A:zenoh-key-literal-majority", evidence:$ra.evidence, evidence_count:$ra.count}
         elif $rb then {layer:$rb.layer, domain:$rb.base, rule:"B:directory-basename-exact-match", evidence:null, evidence_count:0}
         else {layer:"unassigned", domain:"unassigned", rule:"none: no zenoh-key evidence, no directory-basename match", evidence:null, evidence_count:0}
         end) as $assign
      | ($compsBySid[$s.sid] // []) as $comps
      | ( [$comps[] | select(.holon_plane) | .holon_plane] | group_by(.) | map({p:.[0], n:length}) | sort_by(-.n) | (.[0].p // null) ) as $planeMaj
      | {
          id: $s.sid, tree: $s.tree, path: $s.path, kind: $s.kind,
          layer: $assign.layer, layer_domain: $assign.domain, layer_rule: $assign.rule,
          layer_evidence: $assign.evidence, layer_evidence_count: $assign.evidence_count,
          plane: ($planeMaj // "unassigned (no C3I-domain<->architectural-plane joining rule; see design doc gap #61)"),
          component_count: ($comps | length),
          components: $comps,
          aggregate_summary: ($aggmap[$s.sid] // null),
          census: ($censusBySid[$s.sid] // null)
        }
    ]
' "$WORK/subsystems_base.json" "$WORK/ruleA.json" "$WORK/ruleB.json" "$WORK/aggregate.json" "$WORK/components_with_holon.json" "$WORK/census_by_subsystem.json" \
  > "$WORK/subsystems_final.json"

# ---------- 15. Cross-cutting service matrices ----------------------------------------------------
jq -c '
  [ .[] | select((.components|length)>0) | .id as $id |
    { sid: $id,
      logging: ([.components[]|select(.services|index("logging"))]|length),
      observability: ([.components[]|select(.services|index("observability"))]|length),
      security: ([.components[]|select(.services|index("security"))]|length),
      safety: ([.components[]|select(.services|index("safety"))]|length),
      clock: ([.components[]|select(.services|index("clock"))]|length),
      persistence: ([.components[]|select(.services|index("persistence"))]|length),
      messaging: ([.components[]|select(.services|index("messaging"))]|length),
      planning: ([.components[]|select(.services|index("planning"))]|length),
      formal: ([.components[]|select(.services|index("formal"))]|length),
      knowledge: ([.components[]|select(.services|index("knowledge"))]|length),
      testing: ([.components[]|select(.has_test==true)]|length)
    }
  ]
' "$WORK/subsystems_final.json" > "$WORK/services_by_subsystem.json"

jq -c '
  . as $subs
  | ["logging","observability","security","safety","clock","persistence","messaging","planning","formal","knowledge","testing"] as $svcs
  | [ $svcs[] as $svc |
      { service: $svc,
        by_layer: ( ["l0","l1","l2","l3","l4","l5","l6","l7","l8","l9","flat","unassigned"] | map( . as $L |
            { ($L): ( [ $subs[] | select(.layer==$L) | .components[] |
                        select( if $svc=="testing" then .has_test==true else (.services|index($svc)) end ) ] | length )
            }) | add )
      }
    ]
' "$WORK/subsystems_final.json" > "$WORK/services_by_layer.json"

# ---------- 16. Gaps & undetermined --------------------------------------------------------------
jq -c '[.[] | select(.externals==0 and ((.services|index("messaging"))|not) and ((.services|index("planning"))|not)) | .file]' \
  "$WORK/components_with_holon.json" > "$WORK/components_truly_isolated.json"
jq -c '[.[] | select(.logging==0 and .observability==0 and .security==0 and .testing==0) | .sid]' \
  "$WORK/services_by_subsystem.json" > "$WORK/subs_no_core_evidence.json"
jq -c '[.[] | select(.uos_status=="absent")]' "$WORK/census_unmatched.json" > "$WORK/census_absent_unmatched.json"
awk -F'\t' '{gsub(/"/,"",$1); print $1}' "$WORK/holons.tsv" | sort -u > "$WORK/all_holon_ids.txt"
jq -r '.[] | select(.holon_id) | .holon_id' "$WORK/components_with_holon.json" | sort -u > "$WORK/matched_holon_ids.txt"
comm -23 "$WORK/all_holon_ids.txt" "$WORK/matched_holon_ids.txt" > "$WORK/holons_no_component.txt"

# ---------- 17. Final assembly ---------------------------------------------------------------------
cat > "$WORK/layers.json" << 'JSONEOF'
[
{"id":"l0","name":"Constitutional","c3i_domains":["const","iam","secret"]},
{"id":"l1","name":"Atomic","c3i_domains":["atomic"]},
{"id":"l2","name":"Component","c3i_domains":[]},
{"id":"l3","name":"Transaction","c3i_domains":[]},
{"id":"l4","name":"System","c3i_domains":["system","cpig","sync","sched"]},
{"id":"l5","name":"Cognitive","c3i_domains":["cog","test"]},
{"id":"l6","name":"Ecosystem","c3i_domains":["eco"]},
{"id":"l7","name":"Federation","c3i_domains":["fed","matrix","fmea"]},
{"id":"l8","name":"Evolution","c3i_domains":[]},
{"id":"l9","name":"Cosmos","c3i_domains":[]},
{"id":"flat","name":"(flat namespace, no layer)","c3i_domains":["otel","pi","kms","safety","moz"]}
]
JSONEOF
jq -R -c 'select(length>0)' "$WORK/aspects.txt" | jq -s '.' > "$WORK/aspects_arr.json"

GEN_SCRIPT_TEXT=$(cat "$0")
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT_JSON")"
jq -n -c \
  --arg carrier "uos-fractal-matrix/v1" \
  --arg generated_at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
  --arg generator "$GEN_SCRIPT_TEXT" \
  --slurpfile layers "$WORK/layers.json" \
  --slurpfile aspects "$WORK/aspects_arr.json" \
  --slurpfile subsystems "$WORK/subsystems_final.json" \
  --slurpfile svc_sub "$WORK/services_by_subsystem.json" \
  --slurpfile svc_layer "$WORK/services_by_layer.json" \
  --slurpfile interactions "$WORK/interactions_all.json" \
  --slurpfile isolated "$WORK/components_truly_isolated.json" \
  --slurpfile no_core "$WORK/subs_no_core_evidence.json" \
  --slurpfile census_absent "$WORK/census_absent_unmatched.json" \
  --rawfile holons_no_comp "$WORK/holons_no_component.txt" \
  '{
    carrier: $carrier,
    generated_at: $generated_at,
    generator: $generator,
    layers: $layers[0],
    aspects_17: $aspects[0],
    subsystems: $subsystems[0],
    services_by_subsystem: $svc_sub[0],
    services_by_layer: $svc_layer[0],
    interactions: $interactions[0],
    gaps: {
      components_no_interaction_evidence: { count: ($isolated[0]|length), sample: ($isolated[0][0:20]) },
      subsystems_no_core_evidence: $no_core[0],
      census_absent_unmatched: $census_absent[0],
      holons_no_component_match: ($holons_no_comp | split("\n") | map(select(length>0)))
    },
    undetermined: [
      "uos/l<n>/<domain> zenoh prefix (SC-HOLON-NAME-001 target) has 0 occurrences in source; only the legacy indrajaal/l<n>/ prefix is used today.",
      "Architectural-plane assignment (control/structure/runtime/data/messaging/intelligence/language) is only evidenced for components matched to a holon (uos_tui, uos_swarm); no joining rule exists yet from C3I domain plane to UOS architectural plane for the remaining subsystems.",
      "holon.gleam module field for 8 holons (acl, board, coord, holon, manager, ooda, stpa, system_audit) declares uos_tui/<name> but the matching file actually exists only under apps/uos_swarm/src/uos_swarm/<name>.gleam; treated here as a resolved cross-tree match, flagged as a stale/aspirational module reference.",
      "Census-to-subsystem linkage uses substring matching of the subsystem directory basename (>=3 chars) inside the census row name; this is a coarse first-pass triage and produces some false positives (e.g. hermes_fpp_authority matching cepaf.auth via the substring auth).",
      "Interaction rows are capped per kind for report size (sa-plan sampled at 60 of 496 production line matches, FFI at top 15 components by @external count); full occurrence counts are reported alongside the samples."
    ]
  }' > "$OUT_JSON"

jq empty "$OUT_JSON" && echo "JSON OK: $OUT_JSON ($(wc -c < "$OUT_JSON") bytes)"
echo "$WORK"

undetermined: uos/l<n>/<domain> zenoh prefix (SC-HOLON-NAME-001 target) has 0 occurrences in source; only the legacy indrajaal/l<n>/ prefix is used today.

Architectural-plane assignment (control/structure/runtime/data/messaging/intelligence/language) is only evidenced for components matched to a holon (uos_tui, uos_swarm); no joining rule exists yet from C3I domain plane to UOS architectural plane for the remaining subsystems.

holon.gleam module field for 8 holons (acl, board, coord, holon, manager, ooda, stpa, system_audit) declares uos_tui/<name> but the matching file actually exists only under apps/uos_swarm/src/uos_swarm/<name>.gleam; treated here as a resolved cross-tree match, flagged as a stale/aspirational module reference.

Census-to-subsystem linkage uses substring matching of the subsystem directory basename (>=3 chars) inside the census row name; this is a coarse first-pass triage and produces some false positives (e.g. hermes_fpp_authority matching cepaf.auth via the substring auth).

Interaction rows are capped per kind for report size (sa-plan sampled at 60 of 496 production line matches, FFI at top 15 components by @external count); full occurrence counts are reported alongside the samples.
